limitations: Policy decisions are hypothetical offline replay; no deployment approval or causal business-value guarantee.
Observed-outcome, model-implied, operational and missing-label bounds are different estimands.
Conditional selective risk, full-opportunity behavior and deferral workload have different denominators.
Independent support conditions on frozen policies and declared sampling, observation, bounds and exposure assumptions.
Historical stability does not establish future effectiveness. Conformal marginal coverage is not conditional policy coverage.
Sampled resource controls can overshoot; admission defaults are not capacity guarantees.

nomination.rationale: Feasible development objectives, then declared numerical tie tolerance, structural complexity and canonical definition order.

frontier.interpretation: Empirical trade-offs; conditional risk, full-opportunity behavior and workload retain distinct denominators. No statistical distinguishability claim.

policy.conclusion: Observed-data policy selection only; independently supported feasibility and improvement require separate assessment.

execution.resource_qualification: Sampled supervision and explicit algorithm counters; no hard capacity guarantee.
